in_marathi.name: Zairav
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon in the sky
in_marathi.long_meaning: Zairav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Zairav is derived from the Sanskrit language, and it means 'Moon in the sky'. It is a beautiful and evocative name that brings to mind images of the night sky, the gentle glow of the moon, and the peace and tranquility that come with the night. This name is perfect for a little girl who is destined for great things, and who will grow up to be a strong, independent, and graceful woman.
